diff --git a/build.xml b/build.xml
index ff96be798..09695dd59 100644
--- a/build.xml
+++ b/build.xml
@@ -28,8 +28,8 @@
   <property name="test.fork" value="true"/>
 
   <!-- Force java 6 -->
-  <property name="ant.build.javac.source" value="1.6" />
-  <property name="ant.build.javac.target" value="1.6" />
+  <property name="ant.build.javac.source" value="1.8" />
+  <property name="ant.build.javac.target" value="1.8" />
 
   <!-- define other variables -->
   <property name="javac.debug" value="on" />
diff --git a/lib/rhino/build.properties b/lib/rhino/build.properties
index e5503e720..c7f1bca36 100644
--- a/lib/rhino/build.properties
+++ b/lib/rhino/build.properties
@@ -21,8 +21,8 @@ classes: ${build.dir}/classes
 
 # compilation settings
 debug: on
-target-jvm 1.6
-source-level 1.6
+target-jvm 1.8
+source-level 1.8
 
 # jar generation settings
 jar-compression: true
